caption: A new terminal opens at your prompt even when Oh My Zsh is due to update, and your first keys reach the shell.

steps.title: Install a real Oh My Zsh into the tour's own shell home (never the Mac's), its update check due and a newer commit upstream
cmux: [[ $ZDOTDIR == */shell-home ]] && git clone -q --depth 2 https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh "$ZDOTDIR/omz" && git -C "$ZDOTDIR/omz" reset -q --hard HEAD~1 && mkdir -p "$ZDOTDIR/omz-cache" && echo LAST_EPOCH=1 > "$ZDOTDIR/omz-cache/.zsh-update" && { cat "$ZDOTDIR/.zshrc"; printf '%s\n' 'export ZSH=$ZDOTDIR/omz ZSH_CACHE_DIR=$ZDOTDIR/omz-cache' 'ZSH_THEME= plugins=() ZSH_DISABLE_COMPFIX=true' 'source $ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh' "PROMPT='tour@studio-mac %1~ %# '"; } > "$ZDOTDIR/.zshrc.new" && mv -f "$ZDOTDIR/.zshrc.new" "$ZDOTDIR/.zshrc" && clear && echo 'Oh My Zsh installed, its update check due'

steps.title: Open a new terminal tab: it loads Oh My Zsh
